assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity macOS native desktop app UI prototype screenshot for the existing app PadDisplay; this is a conceptual mockup, not a screenshot of a real implemented app.
Primary request: Design an exceptionally refined, buildable macOS 26/27 Liquid Glass interface for an automatic remote-device resolution companion for UU Remote, in Simplified Chinese. One single main application window, light appearance. Render a sharp front-on digital UI image, wide 3:2 landscape at high resolution, with the window filling nearly the entire canvas and generous readable typography. No perspective, no photographed computer, no hands, no multiple-window montage.
Backdrop: a subdued pale blue and violet macOS desktop gradient is faintly visible only around the window and through functional glass surfaces. Standard traffic-light window buttons. The content area is a readable nearly-white system background, not transparent glass cards everywhere. Sidebar, toolbar controls, and subtle floating controls have convincing native Liquid Glass material: gentle background transmission, thin luminous edges, soft refraction and restrained depth, never neon and never thick borders.
Visual language: native Apple utility app, SF Pro / PingFang SC typography, SF Symbols-like thin monochrome icons, 8-point spacing rhythm, balanced white space, charcoal text, secondary gray labels, system blue primary actions, green only for connected status. Native system controls and medium-size rounded rectangles. Sophisticated and quiet, not a dashboard template, not iOS mobile navigation.
Window geometry: about 1040 by 720 logical units, left sidebar 228 units, 60-unit unified toolbar. The sidebar floats visually with a smooth glass background, but conforms to a standard split-view window. Main pane inset 32.
Toolbar: left 'PadDisplay' title, sidebar toggle icon. Right a compact glass capsule contains '自动匹配' with an ON native switch. Separate secondary glass button '恢复原桌面'.
Sidebar: header '设备', two rows with device icons. Selected pale blue/glass row 'iPad Air 13 英寸', secondary line '已连接' and tiny green dot. Second row 'iPhone 17 Pro Max', secondary line '未连接'. Bottom '+' button '添加设备', below a divider '设置' with gear and '关于 PadDisplay' with info-circle.
Main pane: large heading 'iPad Air 13 英寸'. A green status pill next to heading says '屏幕已就绪'. Secondary subtitle '已自动应用此设备的屏幕配置'.
Primary information region: two-column composition with a crisp minimal line illustration of a landscape iPad display on left (screen 4:3 ratio, soft pale blue geometric desktop imagery, visually an aspect-ratio preview, not a real screenshot). Right stacked exact numeric hierarchy: label '输出像素', large '2732 × 2048'; label '桌面尺寸', value '1366 × 1024'; small statuses 'HiDPI 已开启' and '当前主显示器'. Do not show network speed, FPS, latency, metrics charts, or fabricated logs.
Below, a compact understated helper row with display icon: '在 UU远程中选择「PadDisplay」屏幕' and secondary small '屏幕已匹配；连接端可能需要切换一次显示器。'
Lower region: heading '保存的配置' and a medium-size secondary '编辑配置…' button aligned right. A readable, softly grouped standard content surface with two native rows: '屏幕型号' — 'iPad Air 13 英寸'; '屏幕方向' — '横屏'; '连接时自动调整' — ON switch. A muted footer below: '断开连接后，自动恢复原桌面。'
Bottom of main pane quiet action row: left small label '配置已保存'; right secondary outlined native button '立即应用'. Do not add a second blue primary button to compete with the automatic mode control.
At the outer bottom margin, outside the app window, place a small elegant caption 'PadDisplay · 浅色模式概念原型', so this cannot be mistaken for an actual runtime screenshot.
Exact Chinese and numbers must be legible, complete, correctly spelled, without gibberish. Avoid irrelevant decorative cards, browser address bars, fake Open Source repository URLs, watermarks, 3D device photographs, excessive gradients inside the content region, and large hero marketing slogans.

Use case: lighting-weather (UI appearance edit).
Edit target: the supplied PadDisplay macOS UI mockup image. Create the dark appearance variant, preserving its entire layout, window geometry, device list, Chinese wording, exact numeric values, controls and hierarchy. Change only light/dark appearance and its outside caption. Render a crisp native macOS 26/27 Liquid Glass dark-mode window in the same front-on framing. Content background rich charcoal, text off-white, secondary text cool gray, very subtle graphite grouped forms. Sidebar and toolbar use dark frosted system glass that transmits the deep navy and muted indigo desktop behind them. Glass highlights are delicate and physical, not neon outlines. Native blue toggles and restrained green connected status remain legible. The display preview keeps the same landscape iPad shape and aspect ratio with a dark blue abstract desktop. Preserve exact '2732 × 2048', '1366 × 1024', 'iPad Air 13 英寸', 'iPhone 17 Pro Max', all functional buttons and Chinese. Replace the outside bottom caption with 'PadDisplay · 深色模式概念原型'. No new controls, no device changes, no extra dashboards, no transparency that makes body text hard to read.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: three-panel high fidelity macOS 26/27 Liquid Glass interaction UI prototype board for PadDisplay, in Simplified Chinese. This is an app interaction mockup, not a marketing poster. Render a very sharp, readable, wide 3:2 high-resolution board, straight-on, with precisely three native macOS surfaces on a quiet pale blue-gray background. Consistent SF Pro / PingFang SC typography, SF Symbols-like thin icons, restrained system blue accents. Body surfaces are readable standard system material. Liquid Glass appears on toolbars, compact buttons, popover framing and navigation, not on every content row. Window geometry and clean typographic scale match a refined Apple utility app.
Composition: left half a tall device-edit native sheet taking most of the board height; right half an About window in the upper 60 percent and a compact native menu-bar popover in the lower 40 percent. Give the About author text generous space and large legible type. Three tiny labels outside surfaces read '编辑配置', '关于软件', '菜单栏快捷操作'. No arrows, no explanatory annotations beyond these labels, no fake URLs, no photographs, no fabricated QR codes.

LEFT: native sheet, no traffic-light buttons, title '编辑设备配置', subtitle 'iPad Air 13 英寸'. At top a grouped input row '设备名称' with input value 'iPad Air (13 英寸, M2)' and small helper '与 UU远程中的名称保持一致'. Toggle row '此设备连入时调整桌面' ON. Section heading '屏幕'. Native popup '屏幕型号' set to 'iPad Air 13 英寸'. Native two-segment control labeled '屏幕方向' with '横屏' selected and '竖屏' unselected. Under it small helper '按保存的方向应用，不跟随设备实时旋转。'. Output-size row label '输出像素', input '2732', multiplication separator '×', input '2048'. Toggle '高清文字（HiDPI）' ON. Small quiet inline preview '桌面尺寸：1366 × 1024'. Subtle footer helper '保存后，当前连接将应用新配置。'. Bottom footer: left red text button '移除设备…'; right secondary button '取消' and blue primary native button '保存设置'. No extra primary buttons. Controls neatly aligned in native desktop form.

UPPER RIGHT: standalone compact native About window with traffic lights and title '关于 PadDisplay'. In center a modest rounded blue app icon containing a white two-screen outline (display.2), product name 'PadDisplay', descriptor '让远程桌面，刚好适合你的屏幕。', small version '版本 0.1.1'. Then generously spaced exact author credit in one row '作者：耳过清风 · 小红书号：5397290838'. Then exact softer two-line text '本软件开源免费，欢迎点赞与关注，支持作者持续更新。'. Require all ten digits 5397290838 exact and in order; author is exactly 耳过清风, never 耳朵清风. Below a compact gray native button '复制小红书号'. At bottom small native text link 'MIT 开源许可'. Do not add a fake GitHub repository link. Author credit must be fully visible and not obscured or truncated. Keep this panel polite and uncluttered, no influencer photography and no advertisement badge.

LOWER RIGHT: small native menu-bar popover under a paired-display menu-bar glyph, in slightly translucent frosted material, with careful separators. Status first '屏幕已就绪' with green dot and next smaller 'iPad Air 13 英寸 · 2732 × 2048'. Then checked menu item '自动匹配设备', menu item '恢复原桌面', separator, '设备与屏幕设置…', '关于 PadDisplay', separator, '退出 PadDisplay'. App-like narrow menu aligned to its anchor, not an iPhone dropdown.

At bottom of board outside all panels add small label 'PadDisplay · 交互与关于软件概念原型'. All Chinese text must be accurate and crisp. No dashboards, no commercial plans, no sign-in, no help ticket system, no inactive fake links. Maintain sufficient contrast and the restrained native Liquid Glass look.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a precise native macOS 26/27 settings-and-connection-states UI prototype board for PadDisplay. High fidelity, Simplified Chinese, extremely crisp legible typography. Wide 3:2 high resolution. This is a concept design, not a real app screenshot.
Composition: two well-balanced columns on a pale gray-blue desktop backdrop. LEFT a tall native Mac Settings window with readable softly grouped forms, 45 percent of canvas; RIGHT four separate compact native application status strips stacked with breathing room, 55 percent of canvas. Clear native SF Pro / PingFang text, monochrome SF Symbols-like icons, understated system blue, subtle glass in toolbar and action controls, standard readable system material for forms. No broad glass blur over body text, no charts, no marketing.
LEFT exact outside caption '设置与首次授权'. A native rounded Mac Settings window, title 'PadDisplay 设置'. Three section groups:
1. '通用' with row '登录 Mac 时启动' native switch OFF; row '自动匹配设备' switch ON. Underneath secondary text '关闭主窗口后，仍在菜单栏运行。'
2. '外观' with row '跟随系统外观' and noninteractive value '浅色 / 深色'. This is informational, not an extra appearance toggle.
3. '连接识别' with blue monochrome privacy or display symbol, bold '允许识别连接设备'; explanation '开启辅助功能权限后，自动识别 UU远程的连接设备。'; blue medium native button '打开系统设置'; muted helper '在系统隐私设置中允许 PadDisplay。'; a final gray line '也可以先手动应用屏幕配置。' Keep this section useful and compact, no fake permission switches controlled by app, no red security scare.
RIGHT exact outside caption '连接与恢复状态'. Four visually independent native content status strips, each with a status icon, bold headline, short explanatory secondary text, and a contextual small native button only where specified:
A blue progress spinner and headline '正在准备屏幕…'; secondary '应用 2732 × 2048，完成后显示就绪。'. No button.
B checkmark circle and headline '已恢复原桌面'; secondary '本次连接已暂停自动调整。'; trailing small blue glass action '继续自动匹配'. Make this strip especially clear and elegant.
C amber two-device symbol and headline '多个设备同时连接'; secondary '保留一个连接后再自动匹配。'. No button and no falsely ready display badge.
D red warning triangle and headline '原桌面尚未恢复'; secondary '恢复记录已保留，请重试。'; trailing small secondary action '重试恢复'. This is a quiet inline warning, not a scary fullscreen alert.
Each strip should have a normal native subtle rounded grouping and separator, not become a giant transparent glowing card. Use color only to reinforce icons and words. All action buttons have consistent height and proportion. No screenshots of system privacy settings, no device IDs, no internal JSON, no invented precise connection timing promise.
At outer bottom margin put small caption 'PadDisplay · 设置与连接状态概念原型'. Carefully render the Chinese copy exactly with complete words, accurate '2732 × 2048', and tasteful spacing. No other app logos, no QR codes, no advertisement.
